purpose: Teach: ひも/かみ/召/満席/離し/後々/本心/願い事

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、家のひも靴、流行ったな。
lines.en: When I was young, those string shoes were everywhere, weren't they.
lines.style: Gentle, wistful opening. Soft tap on the memory itself. Unhurried, as if leafing through old photographs. Warm gaze settling somewhere distant.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。お祭りのかみ飾り、お母さんが作ってくれたわね。
lines.en: Yes. And Mother used to make those hair ornaments for the festivals.
lines.style: Quiet affection threading through each word. A small, knowing smile in the voice. Pace steady and intimate — she's seeing it clearly. Trails softly at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お料理、どうぞ、召し上がれ。
lines.en: Come now, please have some of this.
lines.style: Gentle hospice in the tone, unhurried. A soft offer rather than direction. Warm attention on the other person. Slight lean-in quality without urgency.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 結婚式当日、教会、満席で、感動したわね。
lines.en: That wedding day — the church was packed. I was so moved.
lines.style: Voice catches slightly on the memory. Wonder underneath. Breathiness on the opening, then steadying. The kind of pause that holds emotion without spilling it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お互いの手、離したくない思いで、年取ってきたな。
lines.en: We've held each other's hands all these years without wanting to let go.
lines.style: Deep, steady voice. The words come with the weight of decades behind them. Slow, deliberate pacing. Not sentimental — factual about the tenderness.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 後々、孫に、この話、伝えましょう。
lines.en: We should tell our grandchildren this story someday.
lines.style: Soft resolve in the voice. Not commanding — offering. Slight warmth on 'grandchildren.' Thoughtful pause before the end, like she's already imagining their faces.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お前の本心、いつも、伝わってくる。
lines.en: Your true heart — I've always been able to feel it.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. No doubt in the delivery. Eyes meeting hers in the voice. Slow, each word weighted. Trails off with acceptance and deep knowing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 今年の願い事、長生き、と書いたわ。
lines.en: For my wish this year, I wrote down: a long life with you.
lines.style: Warm, almost shy in its directness. A small smile underneath. Gentle pace. The vulnerability of stating something obvious and precious all at once.
